newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - UNITED ARAB EMIRATES - AUGUST 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - UNITED ARAB EMIRATES - AUGUST 4.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates' press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- UAE calls for resumption of Middle East peace talks.
- Khatami set to take oath of office as Iran's president.
- Libya's imports from UAE rise despite U.S. sanctions.
- Taleban ready to form peace panel in Afghanistan.
- UAE calls for Russia, U.S. action on Israel.
- UAE imports grew by an average 12 percent a year since 1985.
- Dubai gold trade ready to face challenges.
- South Africa close to $1.5 billion Saudi arms deal.
- UAE says stalled Middle East peace process increases violence and does not serve security and stability.
- Jordanian-Israeli free trade zone to target the Gulf.
